title: RDC 44/2009 - Dispensação de medicamentos em farmácia e drogaria
capture_note: 抓取失败（HTTP 503）—— bvsms.saude.gov.br 当时不可达。本项目未使用该来源支撑任何规则；相关规则改用其它已核验来源。

disposition.detail: bvsms.saude.gov.br returned HTTP 503 at fetch time; the RDC 44/2009 text (prescription-only medicine dispensing) is unavailable, so no rule may cite it verbatim (hard constraint H4).
disposition.remediation: Re-fetch https://bvsms.saude.gov.br/docs/bvsms/legislacao/rdc/2009/rdc_44_2009_10_06_2009.html once the host is reachable; write the capture to research/raw/br_anvisa_medicamentos_prescricao.txt and update the fetch report; re-run tools/check_sources.py and tools/verify_citations.py; then set disposition.status to 'cleared' and clear blocked_for_rules.
